Package io.github.jabrena.juno.util.mvc

@NullMarked package io.github.jabrena.juno.util.mvc
A small model-view-controller toolkit for multi-screen programs on a TFT touch shield.

Each screen is a View; it reads the program's own model, and asks its Navigator to show another view or go back, by the int id that view was registered under, so views never reference each other. A ViewRouter owns the views, runs the frame loop on the calling thread, dispatches new touches, applies navigation between frames and keeps a short back stack; an optional Task is advanced a step every frame for background work without a thread.

Unlike the rest of the API these are ordinary objects, but they follow the same zero-allocation rule: the router and the views are built once at startup, and the frame loop allocates nothing.
